title: [Bug]: Type hint error because of improper field definition
body:
### Bug Description

When using `OpenAILike` type checker like pyright argue about missing `max_tokens` and `api_version` parameters. This is not the case when `OpenAI` (which `OpenAILike` inherits from).
The reason is that for example [`api_version` field](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ad2efcdc5b57c30a3d9cd97ac3a750a0a97551ac/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-openai/llama_index/llms/openai/base.py#L220) is not optional and does not have a default value, but is indirectly set as [optional in the constructor](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ad2efcdc5b57c30a3d9cd97ac3a750a0a97551ac/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-openai/llama_index/llms/openai/base.py#L254). This unfortunately confuses the type checker. Why not make both fields optional and give them a default?

### Version

llama-index-llms-openai-like v0.3.5, lama-index-llms-openai v0.3.42

### Steps to Reproduce

When using
```
OpenAILike(
    model="my_model",
    api_key="foobar",
    api_base="https//whatever/v1",
    temperature=0.0,
)
```
pyright tells me `max_tokens` and `api_version` is missing.
